user_is_member_or_self.name: user_is_member_or_self
user_is_member_or_self.using:
"user"."id" = NULLIF(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM "member" m
        WHERE m.user_id = "user"."id" AND m.organization_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.organization_id', true), '')::uuid
      )
